pages.text: If an action is influenced by a comparator, all of the comparator's influences will act as item filters for the action. However, extra data will be taken into account: block state for block influences, and NBT data for item influences.

Some actions interpret block and item foci differently, but when interpreted through a comparator, block foci are treated as item foci.$(br2)For instance, a pickaxe influenced by a comparator influenced by a fully grown wheat block will create a contract that tells a mob to only break fully grown wheat.
